research_legs.summary: Confirmed on upstream/main ListReadyMRs silently `continue`s with no warning when ParseMRFields returns nil. #4450 does NOT touch ListReadyMRs -- instead it patches the sibling detectQueueAnomalies (used by `gt refinery ready`'s combined output), converting the same silent-continue into structured 'malformed-mr' anomalies for both nil-fields and missing-branch cases. End-to-end operator-visible outcome is equivalent though the code location differs from #4187's original diff.

Confirmed on upstream/main the rig-mismatch skip in ListReadyMRs (`fields.Rig != e.rig.Name -> continue`) has no log line. #4450's diff does NOT add one -- grep for ListReadyMRs/EqualFold/rig mismatch in the #4450 diff returns zero hits. This specific claim from #4187 is NOT carried forward by #4450.

Confirmed on upstream/main, postMergeMR/closeMergedWorkBead close the source issue via a beads client scoped only to the local rig DB, with no routing -- a cross-rig source issue silently no-ops. #4450 fixes this at a better layer than #4187 likely did: it patches the shared beads.ForceCloseWithReason primitive to resolve each id's owning DB (via existing forIssueID/routes.jsonl machinery) and group closes by resolved dir, so both the refinery success path and the manual post-merge path get routed closes with zero call-site changes. Tests confirm both the cross-rig routed case and the same-rig/no-route case are correct (no regression).

Two new beads tests (routed force-close grouping; no-route agent-bead stays local) and one new refinery test (malformed-MR anomaly detection, asserts no wasted git lookups) all directly exercise the changed hunks, not superficial assertions. All CI checks (Test, Lint, Integration Tests, Windows Smoke Test, etc.) are green and confirmed to match current head SHA 143540a6a5 via check-runs API (not stale).

4 files changed, +194/-1, all within internal/beads and internal/refinery -- no go.mod/go.sum or unrelated churn. mergeable=MERGEABLE, mergeStateStatus=CLEAN. `gt pr-sheriff-check --merge-gate --base upstream/main` reports Ahead:1 Behind:57 (WARN threshold, not BLOCK; merge_path_allowed:true) -- ordinary staleness from sitting 6 weeks, nowhere near the #4238/#4257 contamination pattern (~553 behind).

70 files/+4195/-494/22 commits; merge-base with upstream/main is 775 commits behind (dated ~2026-04-22 vs main HEAD ~2026-07-23, ~3 months stale). Only ~5 files/~260 lines (internal/refinery/engineer.go, manager.go, internal/mail/router.go, internal/cmd/source_issue.go+test) relate to the stated fix; the rest (go.mod/go.sum +1582 lines alone, .beads/backup/backup_state.json, broad internal/cmd/*, internal/daemon/*, internal/polecat/*, plugins/*) is unrelated drift from a very old base. Of the 22 commits, only 1 (7fa884a99) is the real fix; the other 21 are stale duplicate-topic commits whose hashes don't exist on current main. Confirms replacement-over-rebase was the correct call.

PR body explicitly credits '#4187 by @Cdfghglz' and names the carried-forward commit 7fa884a995d6581fa2a9c349076cfea4eb67ae5e with its original author. However the actual #4450 git commit (143540a6a5, 'WIP: checkpoint (auto)', author Thalia-geraghty) has no Co-authored-by trailer for Cdfghglz. Narrative attribution is compliant; machine-readable git trailer is missing -- a gap for whoever merges to close, not for Sheriff to fix (policy: don't request contributor changes; a maintainer should add the trailer directly at merge time, crediting @Cdfghglz).

final.reason: PR #4187 is unmergeable as-is (775 commits behind main, 22 ahead, CONFLICTING; only ~6% of its diff relates to the stated fix). A clean, CI-green, tested, independently-authored replacement (PR #4450) already exists and carries forward the accepted bug-fix intent, at a more convergent code layer than #4187's original diff. #4450 is stalled with zero human review for ~6 weeks and has two minor, non-blocking gaps (missing rig-mismatch-skip logging carryover; missing Co-authored-by trailer). Per this town's replacement-PR precedent, closure of a superseded original is deferred until the replacement actually merges -- not merely upon a replacement's existence. Sheriff took no GitHub-visible action (no merge, no close, no comment, no label edit), as those exceed this review-only bead's granted authority.
required_actions: Human maintainer/overseer: review and, if satisfied, merge PR #4450 (gastownhall/gastown), adding a Co-authored-by trailer crediting @Cdfghglz at merge time.
After #4450 merges: close PR #4187 as superseded, referencing #4450.
After #4450 merges and #4187 is closed: the owning rig's Beads maintainer should close nmi-rt5dt referencing #4450 as its fix.
Optional follow-up: if rig-mismatch-skip logging (from #4187's original intent) is still wanted, file a small separate follow-up -- #4450 does not add it.
Optional: correct #4450's stale status/reviewing label once a human actually reviews it.
